theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_si_cutoff_tangential_gradient
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (Tan : Eucl P → Submodule ℝ (Eucl P) → Prop) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P) (t ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → LipschitzWith L f → Measurable G → (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ L) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), Tan x Q → G x ∈ Q ∧ ∀ u ∈ Q, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (x + s • u)) (inner ℝ (G x) u) 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x = t - ε → G x = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x = t → G x = 0) → ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K (fun x => max 0 (min 1 ((t - f x) / ε))) ∧ Measurable ((f ⁻¹' Ioo (t - ε) t).indicator (fun y => (-ε⁻¹) • G y)) ∧ (∀ x, ‖(f ⁻¹' Ioo (t - ε) t).indicator (fun y => (-ε⁻¹) • G y) x‖ ≤ K) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), Tan x Q → (f ⁻¹' Ioo (t - ε) t).indicator (fun y => (-ε⁻¹) • G y) x ∈ Q ∧ ∀ u ∈ Q, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => max 0 (min 1 ((t - f (x + s • u)) / ε))) (inner ℝ ((f ⁻¹' Ioo (t - ε) t).indicator (fun y => (-ε⁻¹) • G y) x) u) 0
